{{Quote|I am Lunatta. Imperial Intelligence marked me their "most wanted", for the thousands I slew on Csilla.|Lunatta|<ref name="Score" />}}
'''Lunatta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] criminal and mass murderer living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] she became an officer of the [[Voidwolf's personal strike fleet]] and later volunteered herself to command it. After the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] got killed by a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], Lunatta pledged herself to the newly proclaimed [[Voidhound]].<ref name="Score" />
